_comment: our own quality gate. scripts/quality-gate.mjs checks SonarCloud results against these after every scan and fails the build if any is broken

duplicated_lines_density.why: copy paste means fixing bugs twice

vulnerabilities.why: security issues are handled in the Security stage, none allowed here

sqale_rating.why: maintainability rating must be A (1 = A, 5 = E)

code_smells.why: cap on tech debt so it cant quietly pile up
